Harmonic frequencies can be considered as echoes of the fundamental frequency. All sine waves have harmonic frequencies.
DISCUSSION
Harmonic frequencies are determined by multiplying the fundamental frequency times the harmonic number.
For example, the 2nd harmonic frequency is equal to the fundamental frequency times 2.
The 3rd harmonic frequency is equal to the fundamental frequency times 3.
